title: Site uses HTTPS
fix: Turn on HTTPS (free with most hosts). Browsers mark plain HTTP pages as "Not secure", which scares visitors off forms.

title: Clear call to action
fix: Add one obvious button above the fold, such as "Book a call", "Get a quote" or "Order now", and repeat it lower down.

title: A way to become a lead
fix: Add a short contact form, a booking link or a click-to-call number. Without one, interested visitors have nowhere to go.

title: Page title is set and the right length
fix: Write a page title of 30-60 characters that says what you do and for whom, e.g. "Invoicing software for small agencies | Brand".

title: Meta description
fix: Add a 120-160 character description. It is the text people see under your link in Google and it decides whether they click.

title: Exactly one main heading (H1)
fix: Use a single H1 that states your main promise. Turn any extra H1s into H2s.

title: Forms are short
fix: Cut forms to 3-4 fields (name, email, one question). Every extra field loses people; ask the rest later.

title: Social proof is visible
fix: Show 2-3 short testimonials, review stars or client logos near the call to action.

title: Phone or email is visible
fix: Show a phone number or email address in the header or footer so people know there are real humans behind the site.

title: Works on mobile
fix: Add <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"> and check the page on a phone. Most visits are mobile.

title: Analytics is installed
fix: Install analytics (Google Analytics 4, Plausible or PostHog). Without it, nobody can tell which marketing works.

title: Structured data for Google and AI search
fix: Add JSON-LD structured data (Organization or LocalBusiness, plus FAQPage) so Google and AI assistants understand and cite the business.

title: Content AI assistants can quote
fix: Add an FAQ section with plain question-and-answer pairs, and publish an /llms.txt file summarising the business. AI answers quote this kind of content.

title: Link previews for social sharing
fix: Add Open Graph tags (og:title, og:description, og:image) so shared links show a proper card on LinkedIn, WhatsApp and Facebook.

title: Links to social profiles
fix: Link your active social profiles in the footer so visitors can follow you.

title: A blog or resources section
fix: Start a blog or resources page. Helpful articles are how most businesses get found on Google and in AI answers.

title: Email sign-up
fix: Offer a newsletter or a free guide in exchange for an email. It turns visitors who aren't ready yet into people you can follow up with.

title: Privacy policy linked
fix: Link a privacy policy in the footer. It is required in most countries if you collect emails or use analytics.

title: Page is not too heavy
fix: Remove unused scripts and compress images. Slow pages lose visitors before they see your offer.
